name: Exp_i-AMMA
summary: This EA trades based on the i-AMMA (Adaptive Modified Moving Average) indicator, opening buy positions when the AMMA value rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses a crossover-like logic comparing the current and previous bar indicator values to determine trend direction and generate entry/exit signals. Position sizing is configurable through multiple margin modes, and it includes stop loss and take profit for risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i-AMMA（自适应修正移动平均）指标进行交易，当AMMA值上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它通过比较当前和前一K线的指标值来判断趋势方向并生成入场/出场信号。仓位大小可通过多种保证金模式配置，并包含止损止盈功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于自适应修正移动平均线(i-AMMA)的趋势跟踪系统，通过比较连续三根K线的指标值来判断趋势方向和动量变化。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标从下降转为上升或下降减缓）且Value[0]>Value[1]（近期值大于前一期值，确认上升趋势）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓。出场条件与入场方向相反：多头持仓时若指标转为下降则平多仓，空头持仓时若指标转为上升则平空仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易的风险比例或固定手数，止损1000点和止盈2000点提供了2:1的盈亏比。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trend-following system based on the Adaptive Modified Moving Average (i-AMMA) indicator, determining trend direction and momentum changes by comparing three consecutive bar values. Entry conditions: open a buy position when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator transitioning from decline) and Value[0]>Value[1] (confirming upward momentum), and open a sell position when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions are the reverse of entry: close a long position when the indicator turns downward, and close a short position when it turns upward. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk percentage or fixed lot per trade, while the 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit provide a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易的资金比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/扣浮亏保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于计算交易信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于趋势跟踪原理，易于理解和维护
提供了五种仓位管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
具备独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关，可以灵活控制交易方向
止损止盈设置提供2:1盈亏比，有利于长期正期望值
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复交易，减少过度交易风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on trend-following principles, easy to understand and maintain
Five position sizing modes provide high flexibility to accommodate different risk preferences
Independent buy/sell open and close switches allow flexible control over trading directions
Stop loss and take profit settings provide a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, favorable for long-term positive expectancy
IsNewBar mechanism prevents repeated trades on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值过大，在大多数品种上可能导致单笔风险过高
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在点差扩大时段可能造成不必要的损失
仅依赖单一指标判断趋势，没有多重确认机制，容易产生虚假信号
没有追踪止损功能，盈利仓位可能大幅回撤后才被止盈或反转平仓捕获
信号逻辑用三根K线的关系判断但Value[0]是最远的历史值，索引方向可能存在混淆风险
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially causing high per-trade risk on most instruments
No spread filter or trading session filter, which may cause unnecessary losses during wide spread periods
Relies on a single indicator for trend determination without multiple confirmation mechanisms, prone to false signals
No trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may retrace significantly before being captured by take profit or reversal exit
The signal logic uses three-bar relationships but Value[0] refers to the oldest bar, which could cause confusion in index direction
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润而非依赖固定止盈
添加多时间周期确认或多指标过滤，减少虚假信号和震荡行情中的反复开平仓
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during wide spread and low liquidity periods
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in more profits during trend continuation rather than relying on fixed take profit
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filtering to reduce false signals and repeated open/close cycles in ranging markets

risk_points: 止损1000点数值过大，单笔交易可能承受巨额亏损
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性不足时可能以不利价格成交
单一指标策略在震荡行情中容易频繁进出场造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large, exposing each trade to potentially huge losses
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during low liquidity periods
Single indicator strategy prone to frequent entries and exits in ranging markets, causing consecutive losses
